author: d
readability_review: All 256 final whole messages read in four blocks of 64. Manual readability revisions and label quotation formatting are preserved as additional revisions. Each is a fictional complete thought; no assertion of an actual solution.
authoring_method: Messages individually composed in batches of 32; no Cartesian phrase-bank or mass synonym product. Python used solely for normalization, letter-count/fixed-position feedback, revision preservation, and internal validation.
blindness: No K4 ciphertext, keys, scores, solution discussions, other-author files, or pilot results retrieved. No publication or scoring performed.
limitations: Constrained English is stylized; motifs and constructions recur. No claim of statistical independence, exhaustiveness, or evidentiary weight as a solution.
